svg.title: Allocate $30,000 Before Expanding Purchase Volume
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-buckets; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate $30,000 Before Expanding Purchase Volume; subtitle: Four cash buckets also reconcile the $10,000 and $55,000 endpoints.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values show one $30,000 deployment, not three stacked scenarios. Bucket details define matching $10,000 minimum and $55,000 upper plans. Card limits are borrowing capacity, not startup equity; uncollected rebates and expected ACH are not cash.; caption: Minimum $4,000 + $1,000 + $4,000 + $1,000 = $10,000; working $15,000 + $3,000 + $9,000 + $3,000 = $30,000; upper $28,000 + $6,000 + $17,000 + $4,000 = $55,000.; stages: label: Committed merchandise purchases; value: $15,000 reserved for documented buying-group orders; numeric value: 15000.0; detail: Allocate $4,000 minimum, $15,000 working or $28,000 upper to acquisition principal. Recycle funds only after cleared receipts; never count inventory and its funding twice.; label: Ticket allocation inventory; value: $3,000 reserved for transferable event allocations; numeric value: 3000.0; detail: Allocate $1,000 minimum, $3,000 working or $6,000 upper to bounded ticket exposure. Avoid illiquid seat-license commitments that exceed the selected plan's loss capacity.; label: Settlement and repayment liquidity; value: $9,000 held outside normal purchasing activity; numeric value: 9000.0; detail: Allocate $4,000 minimum, $9,000 working or $17,000 upper to delays and payment obligations. Size purchasing below cash-covered obligations; this reserve alone may be insufficient.; label: Setup and initial operating runway; value: $3,000 reserved for systems and launch operations; numeric value: 3000.0; detail: Allocate $1,000 minimum, $3,000 working or $4,000 upper to setup, insurance deposits and initial tools. Budget later $1,500–$9,000 monthly operating costs separately.

rect.title: label: Committed merchandise purchases; numeric value: 15000.0; value: $15,000 reserved for documented buying-group orders; detail: Allocate $4,000 minimum, $15,000 working or $28,000 upper to acquisition principal. Recycle funds only after cleared receipts; never count inventory and its funding twice.

rect.title: label: Ticket allocation inventory; numeric value: 3000.0; value: $3,000 reserved for transferable event allocations; detail: Allocate $1,000 minimum, $3,000 working or $6,000 upper to bounded ticket exposure. Avoid illiquid seat-license commitments that exceed the selected plan's loss capacity.

text.tspan: Ticket allocation inventory: $3,000 reserved for transferable event allocations

rect.title: label: Settlement and repayment liquidity; numeric value: 9000.0; value: $9,000 held outside normal purchasing activity; detail: Allocate $4,000 minimum, $9,000 working or $17,000 upper to delays and payment obligations. Size purchasing below cash-covered obligations; this reserve alone may be insufficient.

Budget later $1,500–$9,000 monthly operating costs separately.
